title: Expose bounded Staging Activation OpenAPI schema routes

phases.objective: Add the two declared Staging Activation OpenAPI documents as bounded GET-only Worker routes so public semantic readiness can verify the exact deployed surface.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Both declared Activation OpenAPI documents return through activation-dev.mad4b.com and semantic readiness proceeds without a 404.
steps: Generate GET-only routes from the two registered Staging Activation schema output files.
Forward only those exact paths to the Staging origin with the governed activation host identity.
Validate the public remote documents against the exact local schemas.
Require explicit exact-SHA Staging Worker deployment authorization after merge.
assertions: The two schema routes are public, read-only, query-free, and bounded by existing response and timeout limits.
No wildcard proxy route is introduced.
Provider deployment remains workflow-dispatch-only and exact-SHA-bound.
No DNS, Production, database, migration, ruleset, or secret mutation is authorized.
